description: With Daniel ascended, Jonas Quinn joins SG-1 as Anubis emerges as the dominant Goa’uld threat. Earth launches the Prometheus, the Replicator crisis expands, and the season builds toward Anubis’s search for Ancient power on Abydos.

s06e01.description: Anubis uses an Ancient device to overload Earth’s Stargate, forcing SG-1 to find a way to save the planet while Teal’c’s family is drawn into Jaffa politics.

s06e02.description: As Earth’s gate approaches destruction, Carter and Rodney McKay attempt a radical solution while Teal’c faces the consequences of choosing the rebellion over his family.

s06e03.description: SG-1 boards a mysteriously abandoned Goa’uld mothership descending toward Earth and discovers that its danger is far from over.

s06e04.description: An Ancient woman found frozen in Antarctica carries both extraordinary genetic clues and a disease that threatens everyone around her.

s06e05.description: A small American town appears to be infiltrated by Goa’uld-controlled people, leading Carter to uncover an experiment linked to missing NID agents.

s06e06.description: O’Neill is repeatedly tortured and revived by Ba’al while Daniel, now ascended, tries to help him without violating the rules of his new existence.

s06e07.description: Jonas reconnects with a former mentor who claims Kelowna must build weapons to survive, but the scientist’s behavior raises questions about what is real.

s06e08.description: Two scientists are left behind during an attack and decide to rescue SG-1 themselves, despite having almost no field experience.

s06e09.description: Jaffa rebels and Tok’ra refugees share Earth’s Alpha Site, where a murder threatens to ignite an alliance already strained by distrust.

s06e10.description: An advanced medicine offered to Earth appears miraculous until SG-1 discovers the living source from which it is harvested.

s06e11.description: Journalists are invited aboard Earth’s secret new starship Prometheus, only for the tour to become a hijacking with a hidden objective.

s06e12.description: SG-1 travels with the Asgard to a Replicator world where accelerated time has produced a new humanoid form of the machines.

s06e13.description: An Ancient device makes strange creatures visible to SG personnel, then spreads the ability through ordinary human contact.

s06e14.description: O’Neill is framed for shooting Senator Kinsey, leading SG-1 to investigate shape-changing technology and a covert conspiracy.

s06e15.description: Maybourne leads O’Neill to a supposed paradise containing advanced technology, but the isolated world hides a personal betrayal.

s06e16.description: Nirrti’s genetic experiments on an isolated population force SG-1 to confront a community whose extraordinary abilities come at a terrible cost.

s06e17.description: The United States reveals the Stargate to major world powers, forcing Hammond and the team to defend the program against political rivals and Kinsey’s ambitions.

s06e18.description: SG-1 finds stranded humans who claim their ship was attacked, then discovers another group telling a completely different story.

s06e19.description: Teal’c drifts between life at Stargate Command and an ordinary suburban existence, unable to tell which world is real.

s06e20.description: Prometheus is forced to land on an unfamiliar world where a local government wants the ship and SG-1 needs help to get home.

s06e21.description: Jonas develops visions of future events, including a Goa’uld attack that may be impossible to prevent without changing the very future he sees.

s06e22.description: Anubis attacks Abydos in search of the Eye of Ra, bringing SG-1 into conflict with Daniel over how far an ascended being may intervene.
